candidate_selection.selection_target: observed sales on complete available historical days, exposure weighted predictions; no hidden truth
candidate_selection.seasonal_features: intercept, linear log trend, two annual Fourier harmonics; past weekday calibration

event_identifiers: opaque 128-bit independent stream; no class/date/SKU suffix
zero_denominator: null (undefined); retain absolute error, zero-target count and row
failure_policy: retain failed rows; aggregate metrics null if any prediction missing; never score only successful subset as complete
final_policy: These final seeds were already inspected in v2. Freeze the corrected candidate before retrospective comparison, never call it an independent holdout and do not tune from the comparison. Historical v2 reproduction requires its original commit.
